stations.name: BBC Radio 1
stations.notes: BBC retired plain MP3/SHOUTcast in Oct 2023. Only HLS (.m3u8) and MPEG-DASH remain. A VS1053 cannot decode HLS directly (it needs a continuous MP3/AAC stream, not a segmented manifest). Needs either a transcoding relay on the Pi 5 (ffmpeg re-muxing HLS -> plain MP3/AAC on a local port) or drop this station from v1.

stations.name: BBC Radio 2
stations.notes: Same HLS-only issue as BBC Radio 1.

stations.name: BBC Radio 6 Music
stations.notes: Same HLS-only issue as BBC Radio 1.

stations.name: BBC World Service
stations.notes: Legacy MP3 mediaselector endpoint, reported as still reachable as of 2025 (unlike the domestic BBC stations). Returns a .pls playlist file, not a raw stream -- the Pico-side code needs to parse one line out of it, or the Pi 5 relay can resolve it once and cache the real MP3 URL. Needs a live test before relying on it.

stations.name: Classic FM
stations.notes: Global-owned. Direct Icecast MP3 mount, historically reliable. Not personally verified live -- check via /stations/health.

stations.name: Jazz FM
stations.notes: Bauer-owned. Still broadcasting as of 2026, but no direct Icecast/MP3 mount was found -- current Bauer stations mostly push listeners through the Rayo player / app rather than a plain stream URL. Needs manual lookup (browser dev tools, Network tab, filter for media on planetradio.co.uk/jazz-fm).

stations.name: Heart UK
stations.notes: Global-owned. Only regional Heart mounts were confirmed (e.g. HeartTorbayMP3, Heart80sMP3 on icecast.thisisdax.com) -- the flagship national feed's current mount name wasn't confirmed. Try icecast.thisisdax.com/HeartUKMP3 as a guess, or pick a specific regional Heart station instead.

stations.name: Capital FM
stations.notes: Global-owned. Direct Icecast MP3 mount found in multiple sources. Not personally verified live.

stations.name: Absolute Radio 80s
stations.notes: Bauer-owned. Sharp-stream.com MP3 mount, seen referenced as recently as 2022. Not personally verified live -- Bauer rotates CDN hostnames occasionally.

stations.name: Smooth Radio
stations.notes: Global-owned. Direct Icecast MP3 mount found in multiple sources. Not personally verified live.

stations.name: Absolute Radio Country
stations.notes: Bauer-owned (rebranded from Country Hits Radio in 2021, same station). No direct MP3/Icecast mount was found in research -- likely needs the same dev-tools lookup as Jazz FM.
